macros.name: anchor
macros.doc: Like \plain, but additionally sets a link anchor for the current entry.

macros.name: defbibtabular
macros.doc: This command defines a tabular bibliography.

macros.name: driver
macros.doc: Typesets the bibliography entry using the correct driver.

macros.name: plain
macros.doc: Typesets ⟨code⟩ with the entry data of the current entry.

macros.name: plainlang
macros.doc: Like \plain, but typesets ⟨code⟩ in the language of the current item if the language switching options are enabled.
